description: Source code for the AreaChartRenderer class in the PDFsharp library, responsible for rendering area charts within the charting module.

classes.name: AreaChartRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders area charts, inheriting from ColumnLikeChartRenderer, with methods for initialization, formatting, and drawing the chart.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific information including axes, legend, and plot area.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and space for the chart components.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the entire area chart, including axes, gridlines, legend, and plot area.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Initializes visual formats and point data for each series in the chart.
